summary: Cross-surface consistency + verification (colors/glyphs/quote, run tests, verify live)
description:
Consistency + verification once chat (C2) and blog (C3) both render styled cards.

- Confirm both surfaces use the same Citation card: tradition color (tokens.tradition), tier glyph ◆/◇/○ (tokens.tier), optional italic quote. The quote field in citation.tsx is currently vestigial — now that parseCitationsBlock extracts quotes, verify they render (or intentionally suppress) consistently on both surfaces.
- Section header/footer: chat='References' (+ stats footer: verified/proposed/traditions/chunks counts), blog='Sources' (no footer). Per parent OPEN DECISION, default to leaving labels as-is and aligning only the card formatting. If the user wants one label, unify here.
- Run the full test suite (npm test) — ensure C1/C2/C3 tests + existing prompt/blog-generate tests pass.
- Verify live: (a) the linked by-hand blog post now shows styled Sources cards; (b) a fresh chat response shows styled References cards with no raw CITATIONS plaintext. Use the /verify or /run skill to drive the app.

Depends on C2 and C3.
